verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs confirm event capture works via 'any SDK' and via HTTP from any language, the AI wizard instruments SDKs across 26+ frameworks/languages, and community evidence confirms real-world success with a Swift iOS integration. However, the pack never enumerates or documents a concrete list of official SDKs per platform (web JS, iOS, Android, Node, Python, etc.) with first-party SDK docs pages, relying instead on generic 'any SDK'/'any HTTP' claims. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/list of official SDKs per major language/platform, mobile SDK specifics beyond one community anecdote, backend SDK examples beyond generic HTTP capture claim.
